text:
noah.p: Hey all — first week onboarding. I accepted the org invite but I can't see any repos except the public README. Trying to clone infra/ci and getting 404. I did SSO from the company Okta and enabled 2FA (authenticator app). Any ideas?

emily.hr: welcome @noah.p! Did you accept the invite from the work email on your offer? sometimes the invite goes to an alias and links to a personal account.

noah.p: Offer email is noah.p+redwood@personalmail.com (that's what HR used). My GitHub account shows login noah-p and email noah.p@personalmail.com (I use +aliases).

it-ops: Two quick checks: 1) In org -> People, does your entry show "Member" or "Outside collaborator"? 2) Confirm `gh auth status` and run `gh api /user` to verify login.

noah.p: In People it lists me as "External". `gh auth status` shows "Logged in as noah-p, SSO active for redwood-inference". But I still get 404 on private repos.

sam.infra: If the org marks you External, teams won't be applied. Likely the invite was created as a repo-level collaborator by mistake or the email mapping caused a duplicate account. HR sometimes sends onboarding invites with non-canonical alias.

emily.hr: Hmm — I filled in the offer form with the alias at the candidate's request. Sorry about that. We can reissue the invite to a canonical work address. @it-ops can you remove the external collaborator entry and re-invite to noah.p@work-email.com?

it-ops: We'll need the work email; we can't find a work-email in People. @noah.p please share preferred work address. Also note: if you accept while logged into a different GH account, you'll become an external.

noah.p: Preferred is noah.p@redwood.dev (that's forwarded to my personal address until AD provisioning finishes). I can accept on either account if needed.

sam.infra: Admins should remove the external collaborator and invite noah.p@redwood.dev as an org member. After you accept, SAML should provision your team memberships automatically. If you hit 404 after acceptance, sign out of github.com and clear cookies; browser session sometimes caches the old identity.

onboard-bot: Ticket #4332 created: "new hire invite to alias resulted in external collaborator" assigned to infra-admins. ETA 2 business hours.

emily.hr: FYI we'll update the offer template to suggest canonical work emails to avoid this.

noah.p: One extra question — I only have app-based 2FA (TOTP). Will that block SSO mapping? I couldn't register a security key yet.

sam.infra: No, TOTP is fine. Security keys are optional. The important part is the GitHub account status (Member vs External) and that SAML is authorized for your account.

it-ops: Actioning removal now. After we re-invite, accept while logged into the noah-p account (or switch to the noah-p session if the browser prompts). I'll ping this thread once done.

noah.p: Thanks — appreciate the help. I'll wait for the re-invite and try the repo clones again. :thumbsup:
